searchText: I guess that's semantics. ~~Tips~~Priority fees have to be sent to an eth address; they can be sent to a wallet (EOA) or a contract. Can you please point me to any docs/info about how this process will be implemented. how each validator sets it up is client specific and likely not even built atm. it will be set by the node operator at startup and then passed to the EL via the engine API, see link here: disclaimer, this is all still early https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/specification.md#payloadattributesv1
